scope: Monster AI reachability preparation; world simulation, decisions, Lua, combat and RNG stay on the owner. This is not parallel execution of the complete monster planner.
architecture: A tracker owns its executor, reusable value snapshot and result. Workers read terrain/furniture IDs and owner-resolved descriptors/bitmaps and write exclusive complete columns. No borrowed world, vehicle, field, creature, Lua or SDL pointers enter tasks.

The owner resolves original map::passable for opaque cells whose terrain cost is nonzero. Terrain cost zero is an unconditional rejection in the authoritative move_cost_internal. Furniture, fields and vehicle obstacles retain the complete original rule.

Horizontal and vertical value preparation share one kernel. Only the original dirty bitmap rebuild point can publish horizontal results: invalidate any ready result, capture fresh, synchronously drain all tasks, validate geometry and copy the bitmap on the owner. Fields/vehicles have no geometry stamp, so a cached vertical result never authorizes horizontal republication.

Storage identity/revision covers direct and bulk terrain/furniture setters, rotate, mirror, revert, merge and load. Moves invalidate the source; address reuse obtains a fresh identity. The allocator saturates to refused admission instead of wrapping. Counters are runtime only and do not consume RNG or enter saves.

Vertical reuse checks touched geometry blocks and the queried transparency in one internal mutation-free flood, with no gameplay callbacks. A stale cell uses the exact original owner predicate and invalidates later preparation. Legacy down-predicate asymmetry and existing zone alias behavior are deliberately preserved.

The owner retains original flood, creature and faction insertion order and every random decision. First unmeasured/cheap work, populations below64, nested pool workers, unsupported maps, active multiplayer, cancellation and failures refuse admission or fall back. Measured serial bitmap cost and decaying flood cost admit expensive work; clearing the world resets both.

The hot submap terrain pointer and uniform fallback are adjacent at the object prefix. Version metadata and tracker preparation state stay at class tails. All serialized fields and value semantics are unchanged. Performance is established by the new independent cohort, not inferred from layout.

AI_REACHABILITY_WORKERS defaults to0. 0 is the original query path,1 is the owned serial kernel,2-4 use dedicated workers. Changing it requires a restart. Lua require("ccb") / Platform v1 remains the sole authoring contract.
